title: delta-capture-and-staggered-replay-for-multi-stream-cuda-graphs
creator: Aisha Ramos
description: Problem: We observe intermittent corruption and non-deterministic outputs when concurrent decode streams interleave cuda graph capture and replay under mixed prefill/decode scheduling. Root causes appear to be (1) incomplete kernel/parameter snapshotting during delta captures, (2) stale KV-cache pointers when stream fences are weak, and (3) kernel-selection paths that assume single-stream invariants. Impact: flaky regressions in canary tests and customer-facing latency spikes when fallback to non-graph paths occurs. Goal: Implement a robust delta-capture strategy plus a staggered replay protocol that maintains deterministic kernel snapshots, enforces stream fencing for KV cache epoching, and integrates with the kernel selection heuristic to prefer replay-compatible kernels. Deliver a test harness and regression suite to catch future regressions.
background_notes: Current graph capture strategy: full capture for the first prefill, recapture if shape changes detected. We attempt lightweight delta captures for small state changes but do not fully serialize kernel selection state.
Observed failures include: out-of-order tokens on ~1/2000 requests in multi-stream CI, occasional OOMs when two streams claim fused attention kernels with different workspace sizes.
Related prior tickets: ENG-31107 (deterministic replay validation), ENG-42199 (kernel binding). These cover validation but not delta-capture semantics.
proposal_summary: 1) Introduce a DeltaCapture record that serializes: kernel id, kernel parameters, workspace requirements, attention layout flags, and prefill sequence length.
2) StaggeredReplay: when replaying graphs for concurrent streams, apply an ordering barrier per-GPU that ensures KV-cache epochs are advanced in the same logical order as capture.

3) KernelSelectionGuard: add a lightweight compatibility check at capture time that inspects candidate kernel's compatibility bitmap; if incompatible with any active stream, prefer a conservative kernel or force a full recapture.
4) Integration with scheduler: prefill/decode scheduler will annotate capture with expected max decode length; runtime can decide to avoid delta-capture when likely to change shapes.
5) Observability: emit trace spans and a replay-compatibility metric to the console dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducer (attached) fails consistently on current main and passes on the branch with delta-capture/staggered-replay enabled.
No token-order or output-variance regressions in multi-stream CI for 48 hours of sustained load (synthetic workload matching production latency distribution).
Memory/LOS: No increase in 95th percentile GPU memory beyond 5% compared to baseline; if conservative kernel chosen, document performance trade-off in the PR.
Metrics: replay-compatibility metric shows >99.9% compatibility for canary workloads; fallback-to-non-graph rate under high concurrency < 0.1%.
Unit/integration tests added for: DeltaCapture serialization roundtrip, KernelSelectionGuard mismatch path, and staggered replay ordering under race conditions.

progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Spike completed — PoC delta-capture serialization with synthetic kernel snapshotting. Reproducer produced consistent failure prior to PoC and showed deterministic behavior with full recapture.
2026-02-20: Design review with runtime and kernel teams. Agreed on compatibility bitmap shape and to include workspace bytes + attention layout version in the capture key.
2026-02-28: Initial PR for DeltaCapture schema opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/7182. Contains serializer and tests for roundtrip. Pending kernel selection hook.
2026-03-05: Found an edge where fused attention kernels with workspace sub-allocation differ only by alignment; added normalized workspace field to schema to avoid false incompatibility.

2026-03-10: Staggered replay prototype implemented in branch (github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/7221). Local stress shows reduced token-order failures from 1/2000 to 0/50000 in synthetic repro. Next: integrate KernelSelectionGuard and add CI stage.
risks_and_open_questions: Performance trade-off: conservative kernel selection may increase latency; need to quantify on representative models (gpt-3.5-like and 7B decoder).
Complexity: per-GPU epoch manager adds global ordering; ensure this does not become a scalability bottleneck under thousands of concurrent small requests.
Compatibility: how to handle third-party kernels (vendor blobs) where introspection is limited? Proposed fallback: mark as opaque and force full capture when vendor kernels are active.
Upgrade plan for Dedicated/Private: must ensure DeltaCapture format is backward compatible or provide graceful recapture post-upgrade.
qa_plan: Add a CI job 'multi-stream-graph-regen' that runs for 24 hours under variable concurrency and injects random prefill length changes.
Create fuzz tests that mutate kernel parameter orderings to detect fragile equality checks.
Smoke test matrix across GPUs: A100/RTX6000/AMD MI250 (if vendor kernels present, ensure fallback path exercised).
release_notes: Introduce DeltaCapture & StaggeredReplay to improve multi-stream decode determinism. Default behavior unchanged for single-stream. Opt-in flag runtime.graph.delta_capture=true for canary rollout. See PRs for performance trade-offs and monitoring notes.
